label: 手机随拍 · 当前版
subject: AI-generated fictional 27-year-old East Asian adult woman

assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create ONE believable everyday smartphone snapshot, casually taken by a friend, of a naturally beautiful FICTIONAL 27-year-old East Asian adult woman. She must clearly have a natural East Asian appearance, expressive dark-brown eyes of ordinary human size, softly defined face, a warm relaxed slight smile, long dark-brown hair loosely tied back with a few stray strands near her cheeks, and understated everyday makeup. Retain real pores, faint under-eye texture, small normal skin-tone variations and natural facial asymmetry; attractive without a beauty filter or porcelain doll skin. Casual outfit: plain soft off-white cotton crewneck T-shirt, medium-blue full-length straight-leg jeans with believable creases and white low-top sneakers. Normal realistic adult proportions. Full-body casual standing, facing the friend with her weight relaxed onto one leg and arms resting comfortably, full head and shoes visible. Location: an ordinary lived-in residential courtyard, light tiled or concrete walkway, pale building wall and a little everyday greenery at the edge, not a studio or luxury photoshoot. Soft ordinary late-afternoon daylight, uneven natural reflected light and modest shadows. Shot with a handheld smartphone main camera in normal PHOTO mode, approximately 26 mm equivalent perspective, portrait 3:4 orientation, chest-height viewpoint, slightly imperfect framing and a very small handheld tilt; the woman slightly off centre. Background remains naturally readable, no artificial portrait-mode bokeh. Believable phone-camera processing, moderate detail, a little fine shadow noise and mild JPEG texture; not hyper-sharp HDR or glossy fashion-ad lighting. The image should feel like a good-looking friend in an unedited personal phone album. One person only. No phone UI, no timestamp, no words, no watermark, no collage. No illustration, painting, CGI, plastic rendering, glamour retouching or doll-like enlarged features.

cases.label: 扶腰站立
cases.follows: 扶腰、另一臂下垂和非对称站姿可辨，延续了同一人物的表情与日常穿着。
cases.differences: 腰胯偏移、脚尖和手指仍有变化；T 恤褶皱、牛仔布纹理与背景细节被重绘。

cases.label: 双臂上伸
cases.follows: 双手分开上举、近直肘与站姿可辨，人物和庭院随拍风格延续。
cases.differences: 双臂高度及头部倾斜不完全等同原图；衣服褶皱、手指和背景枝叶有变化。

cases.label: 坐姿托腮
cases.follows: 单膝抬起、手靠脸颊、另一掌撑地和前伸腿可辨，保留白上衣与蓝色牛仔裤。
cases.differences: 手更靠近颈侧，肘膝接触未做几何核对；鞋形与鞋面细节、裤脚和背景透视仍被重绘。

assessment: Qualitative review only. The requested visual direction is an everyday smartphone snapshot, not a claim of an actual camera capture or real-person identity recovery. One output per configuration; no text-only control or numerical measurement.
notes: 用户要求亚洲美女和真实手机拍摄的感觉。当前版改用成年亚洲女性、日常庭院、白 T 恤和牛仔裤、手持手机观感。
人物仍由 AI 生成，没有输入真人照片，也没有真实手机拍摄或 EXIF 依据。
